glosses: to propound (to agree, to harmonize, to concord)

examples.text: Istotne zmiany, jakie widzimy w tym zakresie, lub jakie są postulowane, wywodzą się często z bardzo słusznych przesłanek

glosses: Something assumed without proof as being self-evident or generally accepted, especially when used as a basis for an argument. Sometimes distinguished from axioms as being relevant to a particular science or context, rather than universally true, and following from other axioms rather than being an absolute assumption.
A fundamental element; a basic principle.
To assume as a truthful or accurate premise or axiom, especially as a basis of an argument.

examples.text:
1883, Benedictus de Spinoza, translated by R. H. M. Elwes, Ethics, Part 3, Prop. XXII,
But this pleasure or pain is postulated to come to us accompanied by the idea of an external cause; […]
[T]he attempt to arrive at a physical explanation of existence led the Ionian thinkers to postulate various primal elements or simply the infinite τὸ ἀπειρον.

glosses: To appoint or request one's appointment to an ecclesiastical office.

examples.text: [A]lthough Douglas was postulated to it [the Abbacy of Arbroath], and signed letters and papers under this designation his nomination […] was never completed.

glosses: To request, demand or claim for oneself.
Solliciter, faire des démarches pour obtenir quelque chose, présenter sa candidature.

examples.text: Postuler l’admission dans une maison religieuse.

glosses: Il se dit aussi en matière ecclésiastique.

examples.text: Ce chapitre postule un tel pour évêque.
Tel évêque a été postulé pour tel archevêché.
Postuler la bonne volonté (traduction littérale de la recommandation anglaise assume good faith)

glosses: S’occuper, au bénéfice de la partie que l’on représente en tant qu'avoué, des actes de procédure indispensables à l'instruction d’une affaire.
etwas fordern oder zur Bedingung machen

examples.text: Sie postulierten die Anerkennung der Ehe zwischen Homosexuellen.

glosses: eine grundsätzliche Annahme oder Voraussetzung aufstellen
